name: Star Trek: Elite Force II
description: Star Trek: Elite Force II is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter game and the second in the Star Trek: Elite Force series.

audio_settings.title: Enable headphone speaker mode
audio_settings.reason: The game starts in fullscreen and does not select the headphone speaker mode on its own. This sets windowed mode and speaker type 1, which is the headphone setting.

audio_settings.title: Enable Pro Logic surround
audio_settings.reason: The game starts in fullscreen with its speaker type left at the default. This turns on speaker type 2 and sets the game to run in a window.

audio_settings.title: Enable 4.0 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: The game starts with its speaker type set to stereo, so it never plays rear channels. This sets the speaker type to quad (3) for four speakers. It also turns off fullscreen, which is not a sound change.

audio_settings.title: Enable 5.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: The game's speaker type defaults to a stereo setup. Setting s_speaker_type to 4 makes it send 5.1 audio, which suits a 5.1 speaker system.

audio_settings.title: Enable 7.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: The game starts in fullscreen and does not use 7.1 surround output on its own. This sets the speaker type to 7.1 and turns fullscreen off.

optional_settings.title: Enable EAX 3 sound
optional_settings.reason: The game's sound driver is not set to EAX out of the box. This sets the Miles driver to EAX 3 and the sample rate to 44 kHz.
